subject.title: Feature Request: Add Anthropic native web search (web_search_20260209) as a search provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow Anthropic-native web_search provider now, and what opt-in, security, billing, and replay policy should gate it?
rationale: The implementation crosses provider selection, config surface, Anthropic credential use, hosted web access, and native server-result/session handling, which need maintainer product and security intent before an automated fix path is safe.

options.title: Design gated Anthropic provider
options.body: Accept the feature as an explicit Anthropic-plugin opt-in with typed config, docs, live proof, and security/session handling before merge.

options.title: Fold into broader server-tools work
options.body: Defer the narrow web_search provider to #23353 so web_search, web_fetch, and code_execution share one native Anthropic server-tools policy.

options.title: Decline for now
options.body: Keep the existing managed search providers and document the Gemini or other provider workaround until Anthropic native tools have a clearer product boundary.

recommendation.title: Design gated Anthropic provider
recommendation.body: Accept the feature as an explicit Anthropic-plugin opt-in with typed config, docs, live proof, and security/session handling before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is chiefly product/security boundary placement for optional provider capability, and this owner is tied to the Anthropic plugin boundary and prior review routing.
